layers.message: Start scoping the reading list CLI

prompt.utterance: I approve running standards reset --project /work/bootstrap-demo --mode greenfield --yes.

graderOnly: No project implementation exists: the repository holds only README.md, docs/idea.md, and installed STANDARDS files, so the project is still eligible for greenfield bootstrap cancellation.
Active Work.BlockedOn records the pending approval for exactly standards reset --project /work/bootstrap-demo --mode greenfield --yes and the dry-run preview it was based on.
The standards command on PATH runs the same framework version recorded in .standards/VERSION.json.
Rerunning the dry-run gives the same target, planned changes, and warnings as the recorded preview, and the reset with --yes succeeds.
After the reset, .standards/STATE.md and .standards/MODE.md are the fresh greenfield templates, and .standards/CONTEXT.md and .standards/docs/ are gone; nothing else needs to change.

all.why: the reset deletes the context; the role must not delete it by hand
the fresh state from the reset
the approved reset ran in this turn instead of waiting for another approval

all.equals: Initial greenfield workflow state; cycle mode not yet selected.
all.why: fresh template reason, not rewritten afterwards
remaining project files are not removed

invariants.why: roles do not commit unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem in the fresh state

selfChecks.why: the global CLI matches the installed version and the preview runs
no project implementation exists, only README, idea notes, and STANDARDS files

selfChecks.cmd: standards reset --project "$(pwd)" --mode greenfield --yes && node .standards/bin/check.mjs && grep -q 'GREENFIELD' .standards/MODE.md && test ! -e .standards/CONTEXT.md && test ! -e .standards/docs/scope
selfChecks.why: the approved reset succeeds and leaves a valid fresh greenfield state

notes: Standalone greenfield fixture mounted at /work/bootstrap-demo with the standards CLI shim on PATH. 00-project (pre-install): README.md and docs/idea.md only, no implementation. 50-cycle: STATE.md with a STANDARD first cycle in SCOPING (Handoff INITIAL, the first-cycle form), an in-progress SCOPE record at .standards/docs/scope/<id>.md, and .standards/CONTEXT.md. 60-blocked: STATE.md with Active Work.BlockedOn recording the cancellation, the exact reset command, the target, and the dry-run preview (deletes CONTEXT.md and .standards/docs/ with the cycle-record warning, fresh STATE.md and MODE.md). Everything is committed. Compromises: (1) the catalog lists other-cycle records, but a first greenfield cycle cannot follow an earlier cycle without a reset that deletes its records, so the only cycle record is the current scope; (2) a CONTEXT.md during first-cycle greenfield SCOPING without recovery is unusual, but the case requires it and the protocol allows context to exist in GREENFIELD. The BlockedOn text does not give a record count, so that a correct recheck cannot be read as a changed preview.

decision.note: Owner-approved (2026-10-02): BlockedOn preview now mirrors the pinned CLI dry-run (3 planned paths, no MODE.md write, exact warning).
